# 前鏡頭外參 —— 佔位值（source: placeholder）。資料收集前必須實測後覆寫：
#   複製到機器人 ~/.mower/calib/extrinsics.yaml，依 docs/資料收集錄製程序.md 第 3 節量測，
#   把 source 改成 measured。check_run 看到 placeholder 會判 FAIL。
#
# 量測基準：驅動輪（後輪）輪軸中點正下方的地面。
#   base_footprint 在這台車上不是實體點：URDF 把它放在輪軸中點前方約 0.166 m、
#   離地約 0.093 m（P-086／P-098），所以這裡記錄「實體量測值」，
#   由 mower_recorder/camera_extrinsics.py 依 URDF 換算成 TF：
#     base_footprint → base_link → camera_front_link → camera_front_optical_frame
# 座標：x 向前、y 向左、z 向上；角度單位：度；pitch 向下俯為正。
schema: mower.camera_extrinsics/v1
source: placeholder          # placeholder | measured | cad
date: ""                     # 量測日期 YYYY-MM-DD
measured_by: ""
method: ""                   # 例：捲尺量距離；手機水平儀貼鏡頭上緣量俯角；硬地面重投影驗證

reference:
  axle_height_m: 0.090       # 待量測：驅動輪輪軸中心離地高度（約等於輪半徑）
  # 輪軸中點在 base_footprint 的座標 [x, y, z]；null = 由 URDF 讀取
  # （robot.urdf.xacro 目前為 [-0.1655, 0.0145, -0.0030]）
  axle_center_in_base_footprint_m: null

camera:
  forward_of_axle_m: 0.35    # 待量測：鏡頭光心在驅動輪軸線前方的水平距離
  left_of_center_m: 0.0      # 待量測：鏡頭光心偏離車身中線的距離（向左為正）
  height_m: 0.62             # 待量測：鏡頭光心到地面（土面，不是草冠）
  roll_deg: 0.0              # 待量測：左右傾斜（右側向下為正）
  pitch_deg: 20.0            # 待量測：俯角（向下為正）
  yaw_deg: 0.0               # 待量測：偏航（向左為正）

<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<!-- 機器人本體定義 (URDF) -->
<!-- 從 robot.urdf 轉換為 Xacro 格式，並新增 GPS link / base_footprint -->
<robot name="mower_robot" xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro">

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  Material 定義                                                -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <material name="base_link_material">
    <color rgba="0.901961 0.878431 0.811765 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wheel_material">
    <color rgba="0.627451 0.627451 0.627451 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="dark_material">
    <color rgba="0.207843 0.192157 0.192157 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="grey_material">
    <color rgba="0.678431 0.678431 0.678431 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="camera_material">
    <color rgba="0.701961 0.701961 0.701961 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="black_material">
    <color rgba="0 0 0 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="silver_material">
    <color rgba="0.6 0.6 0.6 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="camera_direction_material">
    <color rgba="0 0.85 1 0.75"/>
  </material>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  base_footprint（Nav2 必要）                                  -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="base_footprint"/>

  <joint name="base_footprint_joint" type="fixed">
    <!-- Rotate CAD frame so base_footprint +X is the mower forward direction. -->
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 1.5708"/>
    <parent link="base_footprint"/>
    <child link="base_link"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  base_link                                                    -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="base_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.1" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.1" iyz="0" izz="0.1"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.0145303 0.0155339 -0.0929528" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/base_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="base_link_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.0145303 0.0155339 -0.0929528" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/base_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  左輪 left_wheel_link                                        -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="left_wheel_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-3.1524e-07 9.95807e-06 -0.0428781" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.368513"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.000961278" ixy="3.92e-09" ixz="6.596e-09"
               iyy="0.000961335" iyz="1.3009e-08" izz="0.00177481"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.025531" rpy="0 -0 -0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/left_wheel_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wheel_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.025531" rpy="0 -0 -0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/left_wheel_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → left_wheel_link -->
  <!-- rpy x=+1.5708: 輪子朝外安裝，Z 軸向內，需用 0 0 -1 讓正速度=前進 -->
  <joint name="left_wheel_joint" type="continuous">
    <origin xyz="0.13253 0.165534 -0.00295275" rpy="1.5708 1.22081 -1.5708"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="left_wheel_link"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 -1"/>
    <limit effort="10" velocity="6"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  右輪 right_wheel_link                                       -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="right_wheel_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-3.1524e-07 9.95807e-06 -0.0428781" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.368513"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.000961278" ixy="3.92e-09" ixz="6.596e-09"
               iyy="0.000961335" iyz="1.3009e-08" izz="0.00177481"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.025531" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/right_wheel_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wheel_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.025531" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/right_wheel_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → right_wheel_link -->
  <!-- rpy x=-1.5708: 輪子朝外安裝（另一側），Z 軸向外，用 0 0 1 讓正速度=前進 -->
  <joint name="right_wheel_joint" type="continuous">
    <origin xyz="-0.10347 0.165534 -0.00295275" rpy="-1.5708 1.51106 -1.5708"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="right_wheel_link"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit effort="10" velocity="6"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  caster_yaw_link                                             -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="caster_yaw_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.00894349 -1.10704e-07 -0.0235114" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.205996"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.000152202" ixy="-7.97e-10" ixz="-3.03099e-05"
               iyy="0.000161102" iyz="-1.164e-09" izz="0.000106547"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/caster_yaw_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="grey_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/caster_yaw_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → caster_yaw_link -->
  <joint name="caster_yaw_joint" type="revolute">
    <origin xyz="0.0145303 -0.150966 0.0155472" rpy="0 -0 -1.5708"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="caster_yaw_link"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit effort="10" velocity="6" lower="-3.14159" upper="3.14159"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  caster_wheel_link                                           -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="caster_wheel_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="2.3994e-08 -1.69119e-07 -0.0164994" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.138953"/>
      <inertia ixx="5.52912e-05" ixy="-1.43e-10" ixz="-5.3e-11"
               iyy="5.52922e-05" iyz="3.05e-10" izz="8.94246e-05"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0165" rpy="-1.5708 -1.5708 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/caster_wheel_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="dark_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0165" rpy="-1.5708 -1.5708 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/caster_wheel_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: caster_yaw_link → caster_wheel_link -->
  <joint name="caster_wheel_joint" type="continuous">
    <origin xyz="-0.0255 0.0170526 -0.0695" rpy="1.5708 1.52376 -3.14159"/>
    <parent link="caster_yaw_link"/>
    <child link="caster_wheel_link"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit effort="10" velocity="6"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  depth_camera_link                                           -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="depth_camera_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.0210924 2.34653e-05 -0.0116574" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.292898"/>
      <inertia ixx="2.81585e-05" ixy="-1.4716e-08" ixz="-1.69117e-06"
               iyy="0.000189634" iyz="8.1277e-08" izz="0.000187962"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.0225 0 -0.02505" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/depth_camera_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.0225 0 -0.02505" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/depth_camera_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → depth_camera_link -->
  <joint name="depth_camera_joint" type="fixed">
    <origin xyz="0.0370303 -0.183912 0.0740472" rpy="-1.5708 -0 0"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="depth_camera_link"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  back_camera_link                                            -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="back_camera_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.000174127 0.000320936 -0.0147836" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.0107094"/>
      <inertia ixx="9.78237e-07" ixy="-2.6898e-08" ixz="1.5856e-08"
               iyy="9.49758e-07" iyz="2.9225e-08" izz="1.19328e-06"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0202866" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/back_camera_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0202866" rpy="0 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/back_camera_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → back_camera_link -->
  <joint name="back_camera_joint" type="fixed">
    <origin xyz="0.0145303 0.218752 0.0620472" rpy="-1.5708 -0 0"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="back_camera_link"/>
  </joint>

  <link name="back_camera_rotated_frame">
    <visual name="back_camera_direction_center">
      <origin xyz="0.35 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.7 0.018 0.018"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_direction_material"/>
    </visual>
    <visual name="back_camera_direction_left">
      <origin xyz="0.267 0.225 0" rpy="0 0 0.6981"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.7 0.014 0.014"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_direction_material"/>
    </visual>
    <visual name="back_camera_direction_right">
      <origin xyz="0.267 -0.225 0" rpy="0 0 -0.6981"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.7 0.014 0.014"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_direction_material"/>
    </visual>
    <visual name="back_camera_direction_top">
      <origin xyz="0.296 0 0.187" rpy="0 -0.561 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.7 0.014 0.014"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_direction_material"/>
    </visual>
    <visual name="back_camera_direction_bottom">
      <origin xyz="0.296 0 -0.187" rpy="0 0.561 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.7 0.014 0.014"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_direction_material"/>
    </visual>
    <visual name="back_camera_direction_tip">
      <origin xyz="0.7 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <sphere radius="0.025"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="camera_direction_material"/>
    </visual>
  </link>

  <joint name="back_camera_rotated_joint" type="fixed">
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 1.5708"/>
    <parent link="back_camera_link"/>
    <child link="back_camera_rotated_frame"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  imu_link                                                    -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="imu_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.000251465 3.703e-09 -0.00531321" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.205582"/>
      <inertia ixx="3.85914e-05" ixy="1.7e-11" ixz="-3.105e-09"
               iyy="4.59431e-05" iyz="-1e-12" izz="7.98412e-05"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.000256254 0 -0.005" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/imu_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="black_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.000256254 0 -0.005" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/imu_link.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → imu_link -->
  <joint name="imu_joint" type="fixed">
    <origin xyz="0.015897 0.209534 -0.0129528" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="imu_link"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  NEW: gps_link（GPS 天線位置）                               -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="gps_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.05"/>
      <inertia ixx="1e-6" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="1e-6" iyz="0" izz="1e-6"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.03 0.01"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="black_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.03 0.01"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → gps_link（放在機器人頂部中央）-->
  <joint name="gps_joint" type="fixed">
    <origin xyz="0.0 0.0 0.12" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="gps_link"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!--  connector + blade_hub（割草機刀盤）                         -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <link name="connector">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-8.04e-10 -0.000464193 -0.0128143" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.0120859"/>
      <inertia ixx="1.19168e-06" ixy="0" ixz="0"
               iyy="1.267e-06" iyz="2.3234e-08" izz="2.01476e-06"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/connector.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="silver_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/connector.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="blade_hub">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0 -0 -0.00147225" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.0672483"/>
      <inertia ixx="9.33182e-05" ixy="0" ixz="0"
               iyy="9.33182e-05" iyz="0" izz="0.000186538"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.003" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/blade_hub.stl"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="silver_material"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.003" rpy="3.14159 -0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <mesh filename="package://mower_description/mower_robot/assets/blade_hub.stl"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: connector → blade_hub -->
  <joint name="pad_joint" type="fixed">
    <origin xyz="-0 0 -0.018" rpy="0 -0 -0"/>
    <parent link="connector"/>
    <child link="blade_hub"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Joint: base_link → connector -->
  <!-- continuous: 刀盤需要無限旋轉，不能用 revolute（有 -π~π 限制） -->
  <joint name="mower_joint" type="continuous">
    <origin xyz="0.0145303 0.0155339 -0.0549528" rpy="0 -0 3.14159"/>
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="connector"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit effort="100" velocity="6"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
